import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    L=np.log(P)
    p=params
    return (p[0]*P*L + p[1]*t*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*P + p[4]*t**2*P*L + p[5]*P**3
            + p[6]*t**2*P + p[7]*t**2*P**2 + p[8] + p[9]*t**2*P**3)
